summary: AI can make software cheap enough to produce by the thousand and still give you more time to make one thing feel right. At AI Engineer CODE, Thariq Shihipar shows how those two futures can coexist.
takeaways: We get into what Thariq changed his mind about with coding agents, how a decision model can choose from actions a designer defines, and who gets to decide which experiments deserve the compute.
Thariq announced his move to OpenAI after we recorded.
At AI Engineer CODE, Thariq Shihipar shows how those two futures can coexist.
